_meta.note: Modelled MSWP equivalent, not a measured value. Depletion fraction is mapped to a stage-dependent MPa range by piecewise-linear interpolation between anchors. Anchors are literature-plausible RDI thresholds (Deloire/Girona/Williams; premium reds run a deeper pre-veraison to veraison deficit than whites). Calibrate to a block with one pressure-bomb reading: there is no universal fraction->MPa conversion.
